title: Storage account
description: General-purpose v2 storage account, private by default: no public network access, no anonymous blobs, no account keys (Entra ID only), TLS 1.2, blob versioning and soft delete.
security_defaults: Public network access off; firewall default action Deny
Anonymous blob access off; HTTPS only; TLS 1.2 minimum
Shared key (account key / SAS) sign-in off: Entra ID RBAC only
Blob versioning on; blob and container soft delete on

replication_type.description: Redundancy. Premium supports only LRS and ZRS.

public_network_access_enabled.description: Allow access from the internet (through the IP firewall). Leave false and use a private endpoint.

allowed_ip_ranges.description: Public IPs / CIDR ranges allowed through the firewall when public access is on.

shared_access_key_enabled.description: Allow account keys and SAS tokens. Leave false: use Entra ID roles.

soft_delete_days.description: Days deleted blobs and containers can be recovered.

outputs.storage_account_id: Resource ID (target for a private endpoint, subresource 'blob')

notes: Grant data access with Azure RBAC (for example Storage Blob Data Contributor); the agent's identity cannot assign roles.
